text_block_list.text:
During her free time, Sakura Laurel was 
doing some self-study.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"C'est en forgeant qu'on devient 
forgeron." ――Practice makes perfect, as 
they say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you don't use it every day, it's 
the sort of thing you end up forgetting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I consciously make an effort to expose 
myself to them. Writing down proverbs or 
phrases in my notebook whenever I come 
across one I find lovely...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maybe playing French teacher in front of 
everyone♪ Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! How about I become your 
personal teacher just for today, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"What's the harm in reversing the roles of 
teacher and student once in a while?♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...During our private lessons, please 
call me 'Ms. Laurel', okay?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Now then, where shall we head?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
When memorizing phrases, it's best to 
associate them with visual images.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Après la pluie, le beau temps." The 
meaning of this proverb is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"After the rain comes fair weather!" Even 
if hardships lie ahead, good things will 
surely follow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I explain it like that in 
words, isn't it hard to memorize?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And so, those memories of that spring—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we got a rainbow precisely because 
it rained! And we got to see such a 
wonderful view together!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you think it's easier to remember 
if you link it to that day when it rained 
during our very first training session and 
we saw a rainbow together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And so, here are three choices!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Between Brian-chan, Mave-chan, and 
Maya-chan, whose catchphrase would you 
like to learn?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Hehe, if that is what you wish—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...The distance between me and Brian-chan. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Please memorize it while visualizing me 
pursuing that path single-mindedly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: 『Va où tu peux, meurs où tu dois.』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
" 'Go as far as you ought to go, and fall 
where you ought to fall.' ...So I'm going 
to do everything I possibly can."
choice_data_list: ……Those are words of resolve, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Yes.

Sakura Laurel's hair catches the evening 
sun. It blazed red, glowing ever so 
fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeeees☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Did you call!? You called!! 
Marveeeelouuus☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha☆ Ahahahaha★ MAAARVELOOOOOOUUUS!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Mave-chan is always such a cheerful 
and energetic girl, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. How are you two doing?

Still smiling, Marvelous Sunday peers into 
my face.

"Whenever I look at that, a warmth wells 
up inside my chest, and strangely enough, 
even I—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Qui rit guérit" —Laughter is the best 
medicine. Smiling gives you strength!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Smiling is a wonderful thing! Let's learn 
it together alongside Mave-chan's smile♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Her smile has the power to make you 
look forward, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Then... let's invite Trainer 
to that place too—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why when Maya falls in love at 
first sight, I go all-in with a full-court 
press!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Maruzen-chan told me, 'Sometimes 
you just have to be patient♪'..."

Brought suddenly to a lovely, adorable 
space. And for some reason, Sakura Laurel 
and I were listening to a young girl's 
romantic troubles...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. For Maya-chan, I shall present a 
famous saying from France♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: 『En amour trop n'est même pas assez.』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much love you give, it can 
never be too much.
choice_data_list:
Those words are truly fitting for the 
country of love.

Those words really sound like they come 
from the country of love.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so the whole country is rooting for 
Maya!?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's quite right...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Then what about you? Are you on 
Maya's side? Are you all for pushing 
forward too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really makes me curious~ Your 
stance on this, Trainer♪

For a while after that, I ended up having 
to sit through the girls' discussions 
about their ideal romances...
